title: Crypto operations specialist
description:
Nova oportunidade para Crypto operations specialist em remote. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About us    Diversas Vagas is a recruitment agency working with companies in fintech, digital assets and online payments. We handle hiring for partners who need people with real technical experience, not just a matching keyword on a CV. This role is open at one of our partner companies, a digital asset business with a distributed team, and we are running the search and the first stages of the process.    About the role    Our partner is looking for a Crypto Operations Specialist to own their daily crypto operations. You will be the person responsible for making sure funds move correctly, safely and on time.    What you will do Handle incoming and outgoing crypto transfers, conversions between assets, and movement of funds between wallets and exchange accounts. Work with non-custodial wallets (Meta Mask, Trust Wallet, Safe, hardware wallets) across several networks, including Ethereum, Tron, BNB Chain, Solana, Polygon and Arbitrum. Manage company accounts on major exchanges: deposits and withdrawals, spot conversions, withdrawal limits, address whitelisting, account verification and support tickets. Choose the right network for each transfer, check fees before sending, and run test transactions before larger amounts go out. Monitor transactions through block explorers, confirm settlements, and investigate transfers that are delayed, stuck or failed. Keep accurate records of every operation, reconcile wallet and exchange balances daily, and prepare regular reports for the finance team. Follow and improve internal security procedures: seed phrase and key handling, hardware wallet use, two-factor authentication, access rights, separation of hot and cold storage. Review operations for anything unusual, follow AML and KYC procedures, and escalate anything that looks wrong before it becomes a problem. Work closely with finance, product and support. You will be the person other teams come to with questions about crypto payments, so clear communication matters here. Help document the process. The company wants procedures written down, not kept in someone's head.  What we are looking for At least 2 years of hands-on experience in crypto. This is not a role for someone who has only traded on the side. Real practical experience with non-custodial wallets. You should be comfortable managing keys, setting up multisig, connecting to different networks and recovering access when something goes wrong. Experience working with centralized exchanges, including withdrawals, deposits, verification and limits. Solid understanding of crypto asset security and common attack methods: phishing, fake sites, address poisoning, malicious contract approvals. Strong attention to detail. A wrong network or one wrong character in an address is money gone, and we need someone who checks twice by habit. Ability to work independently, keep your own records in order and report clearly on what you did. Working level of English for internal communication and exchange support. Stable internet connection and your own computer.  Nice to have Experience with De Fi protocols, bridges and stablecoin flows. Familiarity with blockchain analytics tools such as Chainalysis or similar. Previous work in fintech, payments or an exchange. Confident with spreadsheets and basic reporting.  What the role offers Salary: $240,000 – $270,000 per year Paid vacation Full medical insurance Remote work with flexible hours, as long as key operations are covered Equipment and hardware wallets covered by the company Budget for professional courses and certifications Small team, direct communication, no long approval chains

title: Head of accounting
description:
Empresa está contratando Head of accounting em remote. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About MAVI      MAVI places experienced finance and accounting professionals into senior, high-ownership roles at high-growth US companies.      We maintain a deliberately high bar on both sides of the placement. The companies we partner with are venture-backed and private equity-backed startups and SMEs building modern finance organizations, and the professionals we represent are operators with a track record of owning the numbers rather than supporting them from a distance.      The roles we place are embedded positions within the finance function itself. Our professionals work alongside founders, CEOs, and senior leadership on the work that determines whether a business can close its books with confidence and satisfy its auditors.      Our team has built and scaled finance functions at companies including Lyft, Ramp, and Soft Bank. We remain closely involved throughout the relationship, from role alignment and interview preparation through onboarding, placement, and long-term career development.      The Role      We are seeking an experienced Head of Accounting to own the accounting function across a portfolio of high-growth US client companies, working remotely from Brazil.      This is the senior accounting seat for each company you serve, and it remains substantively hands-on. You will be accountable for the accuracy of the financial statements, the discipline of the close, the strength of the control environment, and the readiness of each client for its audit.      Where a client has outgrown the processes that carried it this far — a close held together by one person's memory, a revenue schedule maintained outside the ledger, a reconciliation that has not been cleared in three quarters — you will be the person who rebuilds them.      The portfolio structure is the defining feature of the role. You will hold several client companies at once, each at a different stage, on a different system, with a different close calendar. The work rewards someone who can carry that context without losing the detail, and who brings a consistent standard to every engagement rather than adapting to whatever each client has been doing.      You will work directly with founders, CEOs, and the leadership teams whose decisions depend on your numbers. A significant part of the role is translating accounting information into something people outside finance can act on, and doing so before they ask for it.      What You'll Own      The Close and Financial Reporting     The close. Lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual close for each client, with full accountability for the calendar, the quality of the output, and the cycle time. The financial statements. Own the preparation of the P& L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement under US GAAP, and stand behind those numbers in front of client leadership and auditors. Revenue. Own revenue recognition under ASC 606, including the schedules, the deferred revenue roll-forward, and the judgements behind them. Consolidation. Own multi-entity accounting, intercompany balances, eliminations, and foreign currency translation where a client's structure requires it. Reporting packages. Prepare the monthly and quarterly reporting packages and variance analysis that founders, leadership, and investors rely on.    Controls, Policy, and Audit     Policies and controls. Establish and maintain accounting policies, internal controls, approval workflows, and reporting standards appropriate to each client's stage, and enforce them once established. Documentation. Build and maintain the close checklist, process narratives, and standard operating procedures that allow each engagement to run without depending on any single individual. Audit. Lead the annual audit or review end to end, including auditor management, PBC preparation, and resolution of findings through to close-out. External partners. Manage external auditors, tax advisers, and outsourced bookkeeping partners, holding each to agreed standards and deadlines.  Accounting Operations   The transactional cycle. Own the general ledger, AP, AR, payroll accounting, and expense processing across the portfolio, holding each to defined turnaround and accuracy standards. Reconciliations. Own the balance sheet reconciliation process and the resolution of ageing items, rather than the reporting of them. Cash reporting. Prepare accurate cash reporting and the rolling cash forecast, and give leadership a reliable view of position and movement.    Team, Systems, and Standard     Client accounting teams. Review, mentor, and raise the standard of the accounting staff and bookkeepers working beneath you at each client. Finance systems. Lead ERP selection, implementation, and migration across Net Suite, Quick Books Online, and comparable platforms, alongside AP, expense, and close-management automation. A consistent standard. Bring the same close discipline, documentation, and control expectations to every engagement, rather than inheriting each client's habits.    What We're Looking For     10+ years of progressive accounting experience, including direct leadership and development of accounting staff Demonstrated ownership of the close and the financial statements on an independent basis, rather than contribution to someone else's Strong command of US GAAP, with genuine depth in revenue recognition (ASC 606); leases (ASC 842) and stock-based compensation (ASC 718) are an advantage Experience leading an audit or review, including direct management of external auditors through to resolution of findings Experience with multi-entity accounting, consolidation, and intercompany elimination A track record of designing accounting processes and controls from the ground up, or of taking on underperforming processes and rebuilding them Demonstrated capacity to hold several companies or entities concurrently without loss of accuracy — prior experience in an outsourced accounting practice, a CPA firm, or a multi-entity group is directly relevant Substantial ERP experience with Net Suite, Quick Books Online, Sage Intacct, or a comparable platform, alongside familiarity with modern finance tooling such as Ramp, Brex, , Rippling, or Flo Qast Experience working remotely with US-based leadership, auditors, and CPA firms, with the communication discipline that arrangement requires Excellent written and verbal English, with the confidence to hold the room in a leadership or audit setting CRC-active Contador, CPA, ACCA, CIMA, or an equivalent professional qualification strongly preferred Big 4 or comparable public accounting experience followed by industry experience preferred Experience serving venture-backed or PE-backed US companies, particularly from Seed through Series C, preferred Direct experience carrying a first audit or an ERP implementation end to end is highly regarded Saa S or recurring-revenue experience, including deferred revenue and the mechanics of ARR, is a significant advantage Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field    Who This Role Is For      This role is well suited to an accounting leader who wants to own the function outright, several times over, rather than administer one part of it once.      You are technically strong enough to reach a defensible conclusion without escalating it, and operationally strong enough to make sure the process behind it holds up next quarter and at the next client. You bring your own standard rather than adopting whatever you find. You are equally credible in a room with a founder, an auditor, and a junior bookkeeper.      Above all, you identify issues early, communicate them clearly to the people who need to know, and arrive with a practical recommendation rather than only a number.      Why Join Through MAVI     Own entire accounting functions, end to end, with direct exposure to US founders and senior leadership Build the accounting infrastructure of growing companies rather than maintaining someone else's Work to US GAAP with US auditors and US systems, on the standard that opens international opportunities Gain breadth across several businesses, stages, and systems in a single seat Progress toward Head of Finance and Fractional CFO opportunities through MAVI Work remotely from Brazil in near-full overlap with the US business day    Work Arrangement      This is a fully remote role based in Brazil. You will serve several US client companies concurrently and will work directly with their founders, leadership teams, auditors, and external partners.    Core availability sits within the Brazilian business day and provides full coverage of US Eastern hours. There is no overnight requirement.

title: Senior accounting manager
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior accounting manager em remote. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About MAVI      MAVI places experienced finance and accounting professionals into senior, high-ownership roles at high-growth US companies. We maintain a deliberately high bar on both sides of the placement.      The companies we partner with are venture-backed and private equity-backed businesses building modern finance organizations, and the professionals we represent are operators with a track record of owning the numbers rather than supporting them from a distance.      Our team has built and scaled finance functions at companies including Lyft, Ramp, and Soft Bank. We remain closely involved throughout the relationship, from role alignment and interview preparation through onboarding, placement, and long-term career development.      The Role      We are seeking an experienced Senior Accounting Manager to run the accounting operation for US-based client companies, working remotely from Brazil.      This is a senior management seat reporting to the Controller or Head of Accounting, and it remains substantively hands-on. You will manage the close, manage the accounting team, and hold first-line accountability for the accuracy of what the function produces before it reaches final review.      Where a client has outgrown the processes that carried it this far — a close held together by one person's memory, a revenue schedule maintained outside the ledger, a reconciliation that has not been cleared in three quarters — you will be the person who fixes them and writes down how they now work.      You will work closely with the finance leadership, and directly with the operators whose decisions depend on your numbers. A significant part of the role is translating accounting information into something people outside finance can act on, and doing so before they ask for it.      Because your team sits outside the United States and the leadership you report to does not, the role calls for someone who runs their area without needing to be managed through it, escalates early rather than at review, and holds both the technical detail and the operating picture across a time difference.      What You'll Own      The Close and Financial Reporting     The close. Manage the monthly, quarterly, and annual close end to end, with accountability for the calendar, the quality of the output, and the cycle time. The financial statements. Prepare the P& L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement under US GAAP for Controller review, and answer for the numbers your team produced. Review. Provide first-line review over journal entries, reconciliations, and supporting schedules, and send nothing upward you have not satisfied yourself on. Revenue. Maintain revenue recognition under ASC 606, including the schedules and the deferred revenue roll-forward, and prepare the judgements behind them for review. Consolidation. Prepare multi-entity accounting, intercompany balances, eliminations, and foreign currency translation. Reporting packages. Prepare the monthly and quarterly reporting packages and variance analysis that leadership and investors rely on, with root-cause commentary rather than a restatement of the variance.    Controls, Policy, and Audit     Policies and controls. Maintain and enforce accounting policies, internal controls, and approval workflows, and recommend changes where the current design no longer fits the company's stage. Documentation. Build and maintain the close checklist, process narratives, and standard operating procedures that allow the function to run without depending on any single individual — including you. Audit. Manage the annual audit or review day to day, including PBC preparation, direct response to auditor queries, and resolution of findings, escalating significant matters to the Controller. External partners. Act as the day-to-day point of contact for US tax advisers and outsourced bookkeeping partners, holding them to agreed standards and deadlines.    Accounting Operations and Team     The transactional cycle. Manage the general ledger, AP, AR, payroll accounting, and expense processing, holding each to defined turnaround and accuracy standards. Reconciliations. Own the balance sheet reconciliation process and the resolution of ageing items, rather than the reporting of them. Cash reporting. Prepare accurate cash reporting and the rolling cash forecast. The accounting team. Manage, review, mentor, and develop the accounting staff and bookkeepers reporting to you, and give the Controller an honest read on where each person stands. Finance systems. Lead ERP implementation and migration workstreams across Net Suite, Quick Books Online, and comparable platforms, and support platform selection.    What We're Looking For     8+ years of progressive accounting experience, including direct management of accounting staff Demonstrated ownership of a full close cycle and the financial statements on an independent basis, rather than contribution to someone else's Strong command of US GAAP, with genuine depth in revenue recognition (ASC 606); leases (ASC 842) and stock-based compensation (ASC 718) are an advantage Experience managing an audit or review, including direct response to external auditors through to resolution of findings Experience with multi-entity accounting, consolidation, and intercompany elimination A track record of tightening accounting processes and controls that were not working, and documenting them so they stayed fixed Substantial ERP experience with Net Suite, Quick Books Online, Sage Intacct, or a comparable platform, alongside familiarity with modern finance tooling such as Ramp, Brex, , or Rippling Advanced Excel or Google Sheets, including comfort building schedules others can follow Experience working remotely with US-based leadership, auditors, and CPA firms, with the communication discipline that arrangement requires Excellent written and verbal English, with the confidence to hold the room in a leadership or audit setting Contador Público (CPN) matriculado, CPA, ACCA, or an equivalent professional qualification strongly preferred Big 4 or comparable public accounting experience followed by industry experience preferred Experience at a venture-backed or PE-backed US company, particularly from Seed through Series C, preferred Experience through a first audit or an ERP implementation is highly regarded Saa S or recurring-revenue experience, including deferred revenue and the mechanics of ARR, is a significant advantage Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field    Who This Role Is For      This role is well suited to an accounting manager who wants to run an operation rather than administer one part of it.      You are technically strong enough to reach a defensible conclusion and show your work, and operationally strong enough to make sure the process behind it holds up next quarter. You build the discipline the company needs at each stage instead of waiting for it to be handed to you. You are comfortable reviewing someone else's work and telling them plainly when it is not right, and equally comfortable being reviewed yourself.      Above all, you identify issues early, communicate them clearly to the people who need to know, and arrive with a practical recommendation rather than only a number.      Why Join Through MAVI     Run the close and manage the accounting team, with direct visibility to US finance leadership Build the accounting infrastructure of a growing company rather than maintaining someone else's Work to US GAAP with US auditors and US systems, on the standard that opens international opportunities Gain hands-on exposure to audits, ERP transformations, and control build-outs rather than observing them Progress toward Controller, Head of Accounting, and Head of Finance opportunities through MAVI Compensation in USD, paid reliably and on schedule    Work Arrangement      This is a fully remote role based in Brazil. You will be placed with a single US client company for the duration of the engagement rather than rotated across accounts, and you will work directly with US-based leadership, auditors, and external partners.      Core availability sits within the Brazil business day and provides full coverage of US Eastern hours. There is no overnight requirement.

Maintain consistency across reviews by following established quality standards and review guidelines. Escalate ambiguous or technically complex cases when necessary and document review findings. Excellent written English, research, and analytical skills. Strong attention to detail and ability to evaluate science and technology-related information accurately, identify factual inconsistencies, and assess reasoning across a broad range of scientific and technical topics.    Preferred Qualifications Experience reviewing AI-generated content, LLM evaluations, prompt engineering, or annotation quality. Familiarity with quality assurance, editorial review, or technical content evaluation workflows. Strong understanding of scientific principles, technological advancements, and emerging technologies. Ability to provide objective, evidence-based feedback while maintaining consistent quality standards. Experience working independently in a fast-paced, quality-focused environment. About Turing:    Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Excellent written English, research, and analytical skills. Strong attention to detail and ability to assess sports-related information accurately.    Preferred Qualifications Experience reviewing AI-generated content, LLM evaluations, prompt engineering, or annotation quality. Familiarity with quality assurance, editorial review, or technical content evaluation workflows. Strong understanding of scientific principles, technological advancements, and emerging technologies. title: Senior marketing designer
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior marketing designer em remote. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Senior Marketing Designer    Shoplift · Remote · August 2026        About Shoplift    Ecommerce brands are under constant pressure to grow revenue while advertising costs climb and competition intensifies. Yet most merchants are flying blind — making decisions about product pages, merchandising, pricing, and offers without ever testing what actually drives conversions. The difference between guessing and knowing can be 15–30% in revenue, but A/B testing has historically been too expensive, too complex, or too slow for most brands.    Shoplift changes that. We're the fastest, easiest A/B testing platform built specifically for Shopify merchants, with 2,000+ brands trusting us to optimize their stores — from fast-growing DTC brands to Shopify Plus merchants. We work with beloved brands like Skullcandy, Our Place, Casper, KITH, and Liquid Death, and we're one of fewer than 80 Shopify Certified Technology Partners — handpicked by Shopify themselves, and the only A/B testing app to earn that distinction.    We're obsessed with our customers winning, and we see ourselves as stewards of the broader ecommerce ecosystem — not just a vendor.    We're a small team of builders who value speed, directness, and getting shit done. We move fast, iterate constantly, and aren't afraid to change course when something isn't working. If you thrive in high-autonomy environments where your work directly moves revenue, you'll love it here.        The Role    As Senior Marketing Designer, you'll be the visual voice of our brand in market. You'll create the lead magnets, ad systems, product marketing materials, and landing page designs that help prospects understand why Shoplift matters — not through words, but through visuals that show rather than tell.    This isn't traditional marketing design work. You're not making generic social graphics or simple banner ads. You're creating sophisticated B2 B Saa S marketing assets that need to match the quality bar set by our product design while serving a marketing purpose. Your work needs to stop the scroll, communicate value instantly, and convert.    Here's what makes it unique. We're a B2 B Saa S company that doesn't take itself too seriously — our tagline is A/B Testing Doesn't Have to be a Pain in the Saa S . Our brand is bold, witty, and unapologetically different, and that's one of our competitive advantages. But there's nuance: we're daring without being whimsical, distinctive without being disorganized, confident without being loud. We need a designer who grasps that balance.  And here's the creative challenge. We're marketing to marketers. Our customers are some of the best B2 C marketers in the world — the people running growth at KITH, Liquid Death, and Casper. They recognize great brand work instantly, because it's what they do every day. If you're inspired by "brand recognizes brand" and want to make marketing design that makes sophisticated marketers stop and take notice, this is your opportunity.    You'll work closely with our Demand Generation org to understand what campaigns need, what's converting, and what to build next. You'll also collaborate with Product, Partnerships, and Customer Success to surface the stories and data that make our marketing resonate.        This is a range role, not a specialty role    You are the marketing design function. In a given week you might build a paid social system, a 40-page ebook, a feature landing page, a motion loop, an email header, and a partner one-pager — and there's nobody to hand the unglamorous parts to.    That means we care more about range across disciplines than a single deep specialty. Brand, campaign, web, motion, presentation, systems, and production all show up in the job. You won't be equally strong in all of them, and we don't expect that. We do expect you to know exactly where you're weakest and to have a real strategy for covering it.        How you'll work: AI as production infrastructure    This is not a bonus point. It's core to how this role operates.    We expect you to use AI to move faster and raise your ceiling — to explore more directions before committing, to kill the tedious parts of production, and to ship volume that a designer working manually simply can't match. What we're looking for isn't enthusiasm about tools. It's evidence that you've built systems you reuse: skills, template and batch pipelines, generation workflows tuned to a specific brand, whatever your version of that looks like.  Just as important: we want someone with the judgment to know where AI makes work worse , and the conviction to not use it there. Taste doesn't get outsourced to a model. If your AI answer is a list of tool names, this isn't the right role for you.  You'll have real latitude to invent this. Nobody here is going to hand you a workflow.        What You'll Do    Marketing creative & campaign assets Design static ad systems for Meta, Linked In, and other paid channels that stop marketers mid-scroll Create lead magnets — ebooks, guides, one-pagers — that look premium and convert Build comparison visuals (before/after, with Shoplift vs. without) that make value instantly clear Design testimonial formats and social proof assets that work across channels Build templated creative systems others can adapt without breaking brand consistency  Brand & sales materials Create feature landing page designs that follow our show-don't-tell philosophy Build sales collateral, one-pagers, and partnership marketing materials Design email headers, presentation templates, and recurring brand assets Extend and evolve Shoplift's visual identity as we scale  Product marketing visualization Design materials that highlight the excellence of the app itself Create motion graphics and dynamic visuals for web Build and maintain a library of reusable marketing assets  You'll contribute immediately — shipping assets from week one while learning the product, our customers, and what resonates in market.        What success looks like    By day 30: You've shipped real assets in market, and you can articulate our brand's edges — what's on-brand, what's a near-miss, and why.    By day 90: You've built at least one system (a creative template, an AI-assisted production pipeline) that makes the next hundred assets faster than the first ten. You know which of your work performed and which didn't.        You're a Great Fit If…    Must-haves 5+ years as a marketing or brand designer with a strong B2 B Saa S portfolio Expert-level Figma proficiency — you build organized, scalable systems Demonstrated, systematic use of AI in your design production. You can walk us through what you've built, reuse, and where you deliberately don't use it Range across disciplines — brand, campaign, web, presentation, and production, with the honesty to name your weakest area You understand brand nuance: the difference between bold and loud, confident and gimmicky, distinctive and chaotic Template-based thinking — you create assets others can adapt and reuse English proficiency for daily collaboration with a US-based team A portfolio demonstrating marketing design with personality and sophistication (applications without a portfolio won't be considered)  Nice-to-haves Motion design or animation Experience with ecommerce, Shopify, or conversion optimization tools Performance marketing background — you understand what makes an ad convert You've designed for marketing-savvy audiences before and know how to earn their attention      How we work, and who does well here    High agency. You'll get a brief and a deadline, not art direction. The best people here notice what's missing and go build it before anyone asks.    Real accountability. You'll know how your work performed — not because someone emails you a report, but because you went and got the numbers. " It looked great" is not a result.    Creative conviction. We want the risky option on the table, argued for. We also want you to let it go when the data disagrees. Move fast, iterate on feedback, don't take revisions personally.        What We Offer Salary: $45,000 – $55,000 USD annually Flexible remote work Generous time off policy Work with a US-based team on a fast-growing product with a distinctive brand Build your portfolio with high-quality B2 B Saa S work that stands out Collaborate with our product designer on maintaining design consistency across brand and product      How to Apply    Apply through this link — applications without a portfolio won't be considered:      You'll be asked to include:   Your portfolio (PDF, website, or Figma link showing B2 B Saa S marketing work) One asset you're proud of (3–4 sentences): show us a marketing asset and tell us why it worked. How you use AI (3–4 sentences): describe one AI workflow you've built and reuse. What did it change about your output — speed, quality, volume, or all three? Where do you refuse to use it?  We're excited to meet you.

title: Domain expert reviewer- music
description:
Nova oportunidade para Domain expert reviewer- music em remote. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About Turing:    Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P& L.      Role Overview:      We are seeking a highly qualified Music Domain Reviewer to support the quality assurance of Large Language Model (LLM) evaluation projects. In this role, you will review domain-specific prompts, evaluate completed tasks for accuracy and quality, ensure adherence to project guidelines, and provide actionable feedback to maintain high annotation standards. Your expertise in music will help ensure the reliability, consistency, and quality of AI evaluation data across diverse music-related topics.      Key Responsibilities Review and validate domain-specific prompts covering music theory, genres, composers, artists, music history, production, instruments, and related topics. Evaluate completed tasks to ensure factual accuracy, reasoning quality, completeness, and compliance with project guidelines. Identify factual inaccuracies, logical inconsistencies, hallucinations, outdated information, and low-quality annotations. Ensure prompts are challenging, relevant, and aligned with project objectives. Provide clear, constructive, and evidence-based feedback to contributors to improve task quality. Maintain consistency across reviews by following established quality standards and review guidelines. Escalate ambiguous or complex cases when necessary and document review findings. Collaborate with project managers and AI teams to continuously improve evaluation quality and review processes.    Minimum Qualifications Master's degree or higher in any field; degrees in Music, Music Theory, Musicology, Ethnomusicology, Music Education, Music Production, Audio Engineering, Performing Arts, or other music-related disciplines are preferred. Strong knowledge of music, including music theory, composition, genres, composers, artists, instruments, music history, production techniques, notation, and contemporary music trends. 3+ years of relevant professional experience, preferably in music education, performance, composition, music production, journalism, research, content creation, audio engineering, or a related field. Excellent written English, research, and analytical skills. Strong attention to detail and ability to evaluate music-related information accurately, identify factual inconsistencies, and assess reasoning across diverse musical topics.    Preferred Qualifications Experience reviewing AI-generated content, LLM evaluations, prompt engineering, or annotation quality. Familiarity with quality assurance, editorial review, or content evaluation workflows. Strong knowledge of music theory, genres, composers, artists, instruments, music production, and music history. Ability to provide objective, evidence-based feedback while maintaining consistent quality standards. Experience working independently in a fast-paced, quality-focused environment.    Offer Details: Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with at least 4 hours PST overlap Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave) Duration of contract : 8 weeks.    Application Process Complete the assessment shared with you. Our team will evaluate your submission. Selected candidates will be contacted regarding the next steps.

title: Cpg supply chain manager
description:

CPG Supply Chain Manager    Location: Remote (LATAM based)    Employment Type: Full time    Salary: $35 K USD      About the Role    We are looking for a dedicated, full time Supply Chain Manager to own demand planning, vendor management, and wholesale replenishment across our portfolio of consumer products brands. This is a company with multiple direct to consumer subscription brands, one single purchase DTC brand, and two wholesale brands sold through major retail partners.      This role sits at the center of our supply chain operations, working closely with our warehouse team, finance, and brand leads to keep inventory accurate, purchase orders on schedule, and reporting visible to leadership. You will be the person who catches a forecasting error before it becomes a stockout, who flags an FBA shipment deadline before it slips, and who builds the reporting infrastructure that lets leadership see inventory health at a glance across every brand and channel.      This is a dedicated, single client role. You will not be splitting your time or attention across other companies or accounts.      Key Responsibilities    Sales Order and Inventory Accuracy Across Channels Own the process of pulling sales orders across all sales channels, including wholesale retail partners and marketplace channels, and ensuring inventory is accurately and promptly decremented as orders ship from our warehouse Maintain a real time, accurate view of true available inventory at all times, since forecasting, reordering, and fulfillment decisions all depend on this number being correct Review and reconcile weekly cycle count data provided by the warehouse shipping and receiving coordinator against expected inventory levels based on sales order activity Investigate and resolve inventory discrepancies, tracing issues back to root cause, whether that is a sales order processing error, a receiving error, or a physical count error Note: this role reviews and reconciles cycle count data but does not have supervisory authority over the warehouse coordinator, who reports separately to the Senior Operations Manager  Demand Planning and Forecasting Analyze sales velocity across all DTC brands and forecast demand by SKU Determine and execute reorder timing and quantities for DTC brands to avoid stockouts and overstock Incorporate seasonality trends and channel performance data from ecommerce, Amazon, retail marketplace, and social commerce channels into forecasting and reorder decisions  Vendor, Production, and Purchase Order Management Create, track, and reconcile purchase orders, flagging issues before they affect operations Track supplier lead times and follow up on delayed shipments Coordinate directly with our overseas production team on reorder needs, production timing, and inventory availability Maintain steady vendor relationships and communication, particularly when timelines get tight  Marketplace Fulfillment Management Own the shipment calendar and deadline tracking for inventory sent into third party fulfillment centers (including Amazon FBA), ensuring shipments are submitted on time to prevent sales disruption Proactively flag potential shortages or overstock situations before they affect sales  Wholesale Replenishment Track replenishment needs and inventory levels for our wholesale retail partners Coordinate with wholesale retailer portals and contacts on stock levels, reorder timing, and order minimums Ensure wholesale order planning accounts for retailer specific lead times and minimum order requirements  Documentation and Reporting Maintain organized, accessible documentation for vendor contracts and communications Maintain a formal reorder tracker and replenishment schedule, kept current and accessible to leadership Build and maintain regular reporting on inventory health, discrepancy trends, and stock levels across all brands, giving leadership clear and reliable visibility Proactively communicate inventory risks and planning recommendations directly to leadership, rather than waiting to be asked Support cross functional projects tied to supply chain systems or reporting improvements    What We Are Looking For Prior experience in supply chain management, demand planning, or inventory management, ideally spanning both DTC and wholesale or retail channels Experience coordinating directly with overseas manufacturing or production teams, including production timing and reorder communication, is strongly preferred Experience with Amazon marketplace operations, including FBA shipment coordination, is strongly preferred Strong analytical skills and comfort working in Excel or Google Sheets for forecasting and reporting Excellent written and verbal communication skills for working with vendors, retail partners, and internal teams A proactive, detail oriented mindset with genuine ownership over deadlines and follow through Ability to work as a dedicated, full time resource for a single company Comfort working independently in a remote structure with regular reporting cadence to leadership ﻿    Why Join Our Team A stage of company where you will help build supply chain infrastructure and reporting from the ground up, not just follow existing systems Full ownership of demand planning and wholesale replenishment across multiple brands A collaborative, low ego team environment where your work has direct, visible impact Steady operational culture that values reliable execution and clear communication

Responsibilities   Perform day-to-day accounting and bookkeeping activities for multiple client accounts. Categorize and review transactions and maintain accurate general ledger records. Perform monthly bank and credit card reconciliations. Prepare and post journal entries, accruals, prepaid expenses, and other month-end adjustments. Support monthly, quarterly, and year-end financial close. Review accounts payable and accounts receivable activity. Record and reconcile payroll entries based on payroll reports. Prepare and review Balance Sheets, Profit & Loss statements, and other financial reports. Investigate account discrepancies and resolve reconciliation issues. Maintain supporting schedules and accounting documentation. Assist with accounting cleanups, catch-up projects, and system migrations. Work with senior accounting and finance professionals to support client reporting and financial analysis. Communicate professionally with the 4 ARC team regarding open items, missing documentation, and accounting issues. Support multiple clients while meeting established deadlines and maintaining confidentiality.    Qualifications:   Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field. 3–5+ years of accounting experience preferred. Strong understanding of accounting principles, general ledger accounting, and month-end close. Experience with bank reconciliations, journal entries, AP, AR, and financial statement preparation. Experience with Quick Books Online strongly preferred. Experience with systems such as Sage Intacct, Net Suite, SAP, or similar ERP/accounting platforms is a plus. Experience supporting U. S.-based companies or working with U. S. GAAP is a strong plus. Strong attention to detail and ability to identify accounting discrepancies independently. Ability to manage multiple companies, clients, and deadlines simultaneously. Professional written and verbal communication skills in English. Comfortable working remotely and collaborating with a U. S.-based team.    What We're Looking For:    We are looking for someone who goes beyond basic data entry. The right candidate should understand how transactions flow through the financial statements, recognize when something does not look correct, investigate discrepancies, and take ownership of assigned accounting work.    You should be organized, proactive, comfortable asking questions when needed, and capable of working independently once processes and expectations are established.

title: Product designer mobile & web | remote
description:
Confira a vaga para Product designer mobile & web | remote em remote. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Ambanga Technologies is a small, fast-moving technology company building mobile and web products. Most of our team is based in Brazil, with a few of us internationally, and we work very closely across design, product and development.    We’re expanding our design team and looking for a strong Product Designer to join us.    We’re looking for someone with great attention to detail, strong product thinking and a real startup attitude . You need to be someone who looks beyond the screen you’ve been asked to design. Someone who asks questions, spots things others might miss and thinks about how the whole experience works for the user.      The role      You’ll work across our products, taking ownership of design work from early ideas through to implementation. You’ll work closely with Product, developers, QA and the wider team, and will need to be comfortable adapting as priorities change.    The role will include:   Product discovery and exploring new ideas Turning early ideas into clear user journeys Researching competitors and how other products solve similar problems Wireframes, user flows and high-fidelity designs Creating prototypes for user interviews and testing Designing across i OS, Android and web Working with and improving our design systems Working closely with developers throughout implementation Improving designs based on feedback and what we learn from real users Occasionally helping with other design or creative work across the business  There’s a lot going on and plenty to learn, so no two days are exactly the same.      What matters to us      Attention to detail is a big one.    We need someone who naturally spots things that don’t quite make sense — a missing state, an unclear action, an inconsistency or something in a journey that could confuse the user.    We also want someone who can work independently. You won’t always be given a perfectly written brief. Sometimes you’ll get an idea or a problem and need to research it, ask the right questions and come back with possible solutions.    You should be curious and proactive. Look at what other products are doing, bring new ideas to the team and be willing to challenge something if you think there’s a better way of doing it.    We’re a very collaborative team, so you need to be comfortable sharing your work, receiving feedback and changing direction when needed. We move quickly and priorities can change, so being flexible is important. Sometimes something else becomes more important and we all need to jump in and help.    We’re looking for someone who takes real ownership of their work . The job doesn’t finish when a design is handed over to development. We expect our designers to look at what has actually been built, use it and help make sure the final experience is right.      What we're looking for     Relevant experience as a Product / UX/UI Designer A strong portfolio showing real digital products you’ve worked on Experience designing for mobile and web Good understanding of i OS and Android UX patterns Experience with discovery, user flows and prototyping Experience creating prototypes for interviews and user testing Experience working with design systems Comfortable working closely with developers Able to work independently and take ownership of a piece of work Very strong attention to detail Curious, proactive and happy to bring ideas to the table Comfortable working in a startup where things can move quickly Fluent English , written and spoken    The setup     Remote Contractor / PJ Monday to Friday The team starts at 7:30am Brazil time , so you need to be available for our daily meetings and team discussions Looking for someone who can start as soon as possible    Please include a link to your Product Design portfolio in your CV.    Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a small design challenge and then talk us through how they approached it and why they made the decisions they did.

This is not a back-office accounting role — you will be embedded directly within US finance teams, operating as a trusted partner to US leadership.      The Opportunity      We are hiring a Revenue Accountant to own the revenue cycle end to end for US-based clients — from contract to recognised revenue to cash.      You will work in lean, high-trust environments where revenue is the number everyone watches. You will own how it is recognised, why it moved, and whether it will survive an audit. What You Will Own     Own revenue recognition under ASC 606, including the five-step assessment, performance obligations, allocation, and timing Review customer contracts, order forms, and amendments for revenue impact, and flag terms that do not fit the established treatment Own the deferred revenue roll-forward, contract asset and liability schedules, and unbilled receivables Own the revenue close — journal entries, accruals, cut-off, and revenue reconciliations — within the monthly close calendar Reconcile revenue and deferred revenue between the billing system, the CRM, and the general ledger, and resolve differences to root cause Oversee subscription billing, invoicing accuracy, and the AR sub-ledger, and support collections with accurate customer balances Prepare ARR, NRR, churn, and revenue reporting for US stakeholders, and tie it back to the audited revenue number Perform revenue variance analysis and explain the movements — price, volume, mix, timing — in terms someone outside finance can act on Maintain audit-ready revenue documentation, including the memoranda supporting significant judgements Prepare revenue PBC deliverables and respond directly to auditor queries on revenue through to resolution Support the broader month-end close, general ledger integrity, and supporting schedules alongside your revenue areas Collaborate directly with US Controllers, CFOs, and finance leadership, and partner with Sales and Rev Ops on deal structuring and billing questions Drive process improvements and automation across the contract-to-cash cycle    What We're Looking For     4–6+ years of accounting experience with strong US GAAP exposure, including hands-on revenue accounting Practical depth in ASC 606 — not familiarity, but having applied it to real contracts and defended the conclusion Experience with deferred revenue, subscription or recurring-revenue models, and multi-element arrangements Experience reconciling revenue between a billing system and the general ledger Strong reconciliation discipline and the ability to investigate a variance through to root cause Experience supporting an audit, including revenue PBC preparation and direct auditor contact ERP experience (Net Suite, Sage Intacct, Quick Books, or equivalent) Advanced Excel or Google Sheets, including comfort building schedules others can follow Strong analytical and organizational skills Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal), with the ability to explain a revenue position to a non-accountant Availability for US time zone overlap    Preferred ARM CPA, CA, ACCA, or an equivalent professional qualification, or active progress toward one Big 4 or comparable public accounting experience followed by industry experience Experience at a venture-backed or PE-backed US company Experience through an ASC 606 adoption, a revenue system implementation, or a first audit    Why Join MAVI?     Own the revenue number for high-growth US companies — the line every investor and board looks at first Build ASC 606 and recurring-revenue depth that travels with your career rather than with one employer Long-term partnerships with high-growth US companies Direct exposure to US finance and technology leaders Broader ownership vs. traditional accounting roles Flexible remote-first work culture Opportunity to grow within a global finance network

Preferred Qualifications: Experience with LLMs, Generative AI, prompt engineering, or AI evaluation. Published research, industry recognition, or teaching experience is a plus. title: Bilingual paralegal / legal assistant
description:
Empresa está contratando Bilingual paralegal / legal assistant em remote. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Company Description      Catalyze X is a leading outsourcing partner specializing in delivering cost-effective and highly efficient labor solutions to businesses across various industries. We help companies scale their operations and achieve sustainable growth by providing top-tier talent and support.      Role Description      Catalyze X is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Bilingual Paralegal (Spanish/English) to join our remote legal team. In this role, you will oversee the full lifecycle of case managementfrom intake through case closingserving as a central hub for document management and case organization. You will support attorneys and senior paralegals, ensuring all case materials are accurate, properly filed, and easily accessible, while helping maintain smooth workflows across the team.      Key Responsibilities      Case Intake & Opening Process all new client intake information and documentation. Create and organize new case files in legal case management systems. Prepare engagement letters, conflict checks, intake forms, and other opening documents. Coordinate with attorneys to ensure complete and accurate intake information. Maintain case opening checklists to ensure consistency across all matters.  Case Management & Closing Monitor ongoing cases and ensure case data is accurate and up-to-date. Coordinate with attorneys to identify cases ready for closure. Execute case closing procedures, including final billing, archiving documents, and updating case status. Prepare case closing memoranda and coordinate return or destruction of client materials.  Document Management & Discovery Serve as the central resource for locating and retrieving case documents and discovery materials. Maintain organized electronic and physical filing systems with consistent naming conventions. Manage discovery materials, including indexing, tracking, and archiving. Conduct periodic audits of case files to ensure compliance with filing standards. Support attorneys and staff in document preparation, version control, and proper storage.  Administrative & Client Support Provide general administrative support, including managing emails, phone calls, and calendars. Assist with scheduling meetings and coordinating case-related communications. Serve as a secondary point of contact for clients, providing updates and addressing inquiries. Draft, file, and process legal documents and correspondence as assigned.  Qualifications Bilingual: Spanish and English proficiency required; must be based in Brazil or Latin America. Strong American English communication skills (spoken and written). Knowledge of legal procedures, case management, and document handling. Exceptional organizational and multitasking abilities with strong attention to detail. Experience with legal case management software and cloud-based document systems. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in a fast-paced environment. Background in workers' compensation and personal injury law preferred.  Technical Requirements    Internet connection: High-speed internet required — minimum 20 Mbps or fiber connection    Computer / laptop: Employees must use a genuine, supported business laptop with built-in hardware security and full-disk encryption enabled. Unsupported, modified, bypass-installed, rooted, or jailbroken operating systems are not permitted.   Windows: Windows 11 (preferably Windows 11 Pro), 2021 model or newer, with TPM 2.0 enabled and Bit Locker / Windows Device Encryption turned on Mac: Apple Mac Book / Mac, 2020 model or newer, preferably Apple Silicon M1 or newer, running a supported mac OS version with File Vault enabled Not permitted: Chromebooks (Chrome OS), tablets, and mobile devices are not supported and cannot be used for this role  RAM: Minimum 8 GB (16 GB preferred)    Noise-canceling headset    Power and internet backup required    Compensation: $7 per hour    Working Hours: Eastern or Pacific Time Zone     If you are highly organized, proactive, and eager to contribute to a growing legal team, we encourage you to apply. Please submit your application through our Careers Page ; only applications submitted via the career page form will be considered.  Link:

title: Retail credit risk manager
description:
Confira a vaga para Retail credit risk manager em remote. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About Revolut    People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.    As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.      About the role    Risk at Revolut operates across all functions, products, and regions to monitor front-line performance and ensure the business operates safely. They’re among the first to be involved in new initiatives, from tech to customer support.    We’re looking for a Risk Manager who'll support growing our retail credit portfolio. You'll make data-driven decisions on risk-adjusted return requirements and lead preventive and reactive actions that impact portfolio credit performance and profitability.    Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch.      What you'll be doing Overseeing exposure to retail credit risk Working with the Risk Modelling team to design, develop, and implement retail credit risk models Managing risk appetite through limit calibration and monitoring Maintaining key policies, procedures, and controls Engaging with first-line businesses to identify, monitor, and govern emerging retail credit risks, including new product risk assessments Engaging with key stakeholders, committees, and regional regulators on material retail credit risk exposures and limit governance Quantifying risk exposures within the organisation, taking into consideration stakeholder impact Protecting the company from excessive risk-taking, saving on both short and long-term costs Building trust and reputation with our external stakeholders and ensuring risks are managed within the risk appetite Identifying emerging risks that require immediate attention or could threaten long-term viability    What you'll need Experience in consumer credit risk within a financial institution, bank, asset management, payment institution, and/or related services firm Knowledge of key lending products, like credit cards, personal loans, buy now-pay later, and/or mortgages A quantitative background in STEM (science, technology, engineering, and mathematics), statistics, economics, or related fields Fluency in English    Nice to have Experience in the second line of defence (risk) Impressive programming skills using Python, R, and/or SQL      Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D& I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.  Important notice for candidates:  Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles. • Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment. • Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an@ domain.  We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.  By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Sr. workday financials consultant
description:
Empresa está contratando Sr. workday financials consultant em remote. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Senior Workday Financials Consultant    About the Role    Aspire is looking for a Senior Workday Financials Consultant to join our Finance Solution Delivery team on a contract basis.  In this role, you will serve as a versatile Workday Financials subject matter expert , supporting production operations, system enhancements, and strategic Finance transformation initiatives.  You will work closely with Finance, Accounting, Procurement, and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure the Workday Financials platform remains stable, scalable, and continuously optimized.  This is an ideal opportunity for an experienced Workday Financials professional who can work independently, solve complex problems, and provide hands-on expertise across multiple Financials domains.    Key Responsibilities   Provide hands-on configuration, administration, and production support across Workday Financials. Troubleshoot system issues, investigate defects, and provide timely and effective resolutions. Partner with Finance, Accounting, Procurement, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into scalable Workday solutions. Support multiple Financials domains and adapt to changing business priorities. Design, configure, and optimize Workday solutions with a focus on scalability, maintainability, and long-term platform health. Deliver system enhancements, optimizations, and continuous improvement initiatives. Collaborate with technical and functional teams on reporting, integrations, and platform enhancements . Support strategic Finance transformation initiatives and future Workday capabilities. Maintain clear and accurate documentation for configurations, business processes, and solution designs. Work effectively in a fast-paced and collaborative environment with stakeholders across U. S. time zones.  Required Qualifications   8–10 years of hands-on Workday Financials experience. Strong understanding of end-to-end financial processes within Workday . Proven experience supporting both production environments and project-based initiatives . Ability to work independently and effectively in a fast-paced and sometimes ambiguous environment. Strong problem-solving, analytical, and systems-thinking skills. Demonstrated expertise across multiple Workday Financials domains.  Priority Workday Financials Areas    Highest Priority Financial Accounting Expenses Business Assets  Secondary Priority Banking & Settlement  Nice to Have VNDLY experience  Lower Priority Procurement experience — the organization is gradually phasing this area out.  What Success Looks Like    In this role, success means you:   Seamlessly support multiple Workday Financials domains based on business priorities. Reduce the production support backlog and improve responsiveness to Finance stakeholders. Deliver scalable, maintainable solutions rather than short-term fixes. Resolve issues efficiently while minimizing business disruption. Become a trusted extension of the core Workday team. Contribute to continuous improvement and long-term Finance transformation initiatives.  Why Aspire?   Join a Remote-First organization. Work alongside exceptional technology professionals from around the world. Access continuous technical and professional development opportunities. Gain international exposure by collaborating with global technology leaders. Receive nursery reimbursement benefits. Participate in virtual and onsite international technology conferences. Work within an IT environment aligned with rigorous security and compliance standards, including ISO and SOC frameworks .

title: Domain expert - history
description:
Confira a vaga para Domain expert - history em remote. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About Turing:    Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.      Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.      Role Overview:    We are seeking a highly qualified History Domain Expert to evaluate and improve Large Language Models (LLMs). You will design challenging prompts, assess factual accuracy and reasoning, and identify knowledge gaps within ancient, medieval, modern, political, military, archaeology, and historiography.      Key Responsibilities Create advanced prompts covering ancient, medieval, modern, political, military, archaeology, and historiography. Evaluate AI-generated responses for factual accuracy, reasoning quality, completeness, and nuance. Identify hallucinations, logical inconsistencies, outdated information, and edge cases. Develop benchmark datasets and adversarial test cases. Provide evidence-based feedback with reliable references. Collaborate with AI researchers to improve model performance. Maintain high annotation quality and documentation.    Day - to - day task: Write domain-specific prompts of varying difficulty. Compare multiple AI responses and rank them. Explain why a response is correct or incorrect using authoritative references. Identify ambiguous questions and propose improved prompts.    Minimum Qualifications: Master’s degree or higher in any field; degrees in History, Archaeology, Classics, Cultural Studies, Anthropology, Humanities, or other history-related disciplines are preferred. Strong knowledge of history, including familiarity with major historical periods, events, civilizations, political and social movements, notable figures, and cultural developments across one or more regions or periods. 3+ years of relevant professional experience, preferably in historical research, academia, education, journalism, publishing, museums, archives, historical content development, or a related field. Excellent written English, research, and analytical skills. Strong attention to detail and ability to assess historical information, chronology, sources, and context accurately.    Preferred Qualifications: Experience with LLMs, Generative AI, prompt engineering, or AI evaluation. Published research, industry recognition, or teaching experience is a plus. Ability to work independently and provide objective, evidence-backed reviews. Offer Details:    Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with at least 4 hours PST overlap Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave) Duration of contract : 8 weeks.    Application Process: Complete the assessment shared with you. Our team will evaluate your submission. Selected candidates will be contacted regarding the next steps.

title: Director of strategic partnerships
description:
Confira a vaga para Director of strategic partnerships em remote. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

ABOUT ELIFE    Elife is the unified API infrastructure behind global mobility and instant delivery across 182 countries. We power Super Apps, Fin Techs, neobanks, and ride-hailing ecosystems worldwide — we don't compete with them, we enable them. Our partners integrate once and serve their users globally. We build and operate the infrastructure. Our partners own the brand and the customer relationship. We do not compete for our partners' users.      THE ROLE    We are looking for a proven ecosystem hunter — not an account manager, not a loyalty program builder, not a co-marketing specialist. Someone who has personally closed bidirectional commercial deals where both parties share live transaction revenue, through API integrations with super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, or mobility companies.    This is a greenfield, individual contributor role. You will build elife's LATAM pipeline from zero, own the full deal lifecycle from outreach to signed contract, and be expected to deliver active pipeline within the first 90 days.      WHAT YOU WILL DO Identify, engage and close strategic partnerships with super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, ride-hailing operators and e-commerce ecosystems across LATAM Own the full commercial lifecycle — outreach, negotiation, deal structuring, contract execution and partner onboarding Structure and close revenue-share and API integration agreements where elife's infrastructure powers mobility and delivery services inside a partner's platform Build and maintain 20+ active enterprise prospects at any given time Engage C-suite and VP-level decision makers directly — no intermediaries Represent elife at industry events and forums across LATAM Report pipeline, forecasts and market intelligence directly to the VP of Partnerships    WHAT WE NEED — NON-NEGOTIABLE 8+ years of B2 B enterprise partnerships experience Minimum 3 years of direct experience closing ecosystem deals with or inside super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, or ride-hailing companies in LATAM Proven track record closing bidirectional revenue-share deals — where revenue is generated by live transactions, not loyalty points, discount campaigns or co-marketing budgets Direct experience structuring and closing API integration partnerships commercially — owning the business case, commercial terms and deal execution end-to-end Active C-suite network verifiable with specific names in at least two of the following: Rappi, Uber, Di Di, Mercado Pago, Nu, Clip, Stori, Kavak, i Food or equivalent LATAM super apps or neobanks Multi-country LATAM experience — Mexico and/or Brazil required; Colombia, Argentina, Chile a plus Hunter DNA — you have built pipelines from zero, not inherited them Fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese required; English proficiency required Bachelor's degree minimum; MBA strongly preferred    PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Prior experience working with or for mobility platforms, ride-hailing operators, corporate travel or fleet technology companies Track record closing first-of-kind or complex ecosystem partnerships with measurable commercial outcomes Experience managing partnerships across multiple LATAM countries simultaneously Familiarity with the regulatory and payments landscape across Brazil, Mexico and Colombia    WHAT WE OFFER Fixed monthly base + KPI bonus scalable up to 300% based on commercial results Uncapped commissions tied directly to the revenue you generate Remote-first with regional travel as required Direct access to C-suite and founder leadership from day one A genuinely entrepreneurial environment where your deals shape elife's growth trajectory in LATAM    MARKET CONTEXT    Latin America is one of the fastest-growing digital financial services markets in the world, led by Brazil and Mexico. The region is home to a dynamic ecosystem of super apps, neobanks, and ride-hailing operators actively seeking scalable mobility and delivery partnerships. The Director of Strategic Partnerships for LATAM will build elife's presence from the ground up in this high-potential, relationship-driven market — and earn accordingly.

da política de investimentos e alocação de recursos próprios e de terceiros (renda fixa, TPF, compromissadas), respeitando as normas de segregação patrimonial do Banco Central para IPs.Gestão da relação institucional e operacional com Sponsor Banks, bancos liquidantes e custodiantes.Negociação de tarifas, spreads, limites operacionais e SLAs para dar escala aos produtos de Baa S.Garantir a aderência às normas regulatórias aplicáveis a Instituições de Pagamento e emissores de moeda eletrônica.Liderar melhorias, automações e integrações via API no TMS (Treasury Management System) e A Swap é uma plataforma de tecnologia especializada em soluções financeiras B2 B, criando infraestrutura para que empresas lancem seus próprios produtos financeiros e gerem mais riqueza dentro de seus ecossistemas. Nossa missão é clara: transformar mercados e comunidades através da tecnologia, permitindo que empresas ofereçam cartões, contas digitais, pagamentos, integrações via API e soluções financeiras completas com sua própria marca. Geramos impacto direto na vida de milhares de empresas e milhões de trabalhadores no Brasil.Aqui, acreditamos que o futuro do Baa S nasce da combinação entre especialização, tecnologia, parceria e propósito. Na Swap, você não encontra só um emprego, encontra a chance de construir um legado.Nossa Cultura e Valores Os pilares que guiam nossas decisões, comportamentos e forma de fazer negócios:Esses valores formam a base do nosso crescimento e garantem que a Swap ocupe o território desejado no imaginário dos públicos que servimos.Esses reconhecimentos mostram o impacto do que construímos aqui dentro e reforçam para quem busca fazer parte da Swap que nosso trabalho é levado a sério pelo mercado. Cada selo evidencia nosso compromisso com inovação, tecnologia de ponta e um ambiente onde desafios reais geram crescimento profissional.A Swap oferece uma infraestrutura completa de serviços financeiros que inclui:Emissão de cartões (crédito, débito e pré-pago, com marca própria).Contas digitais personalizadas.Processamento de pagamentos online e offline.APIs robustas para integração com qualquer plataforma.Soluções de conformidade regulatória, onboarding e segurança.Nosso modelo de atuação é pautado por três pilares fundamentais:Especialização: soluções desenhadas para mercados e nichos específicos.Transformação: tecnologia e know-how para gerar impacto real em setores inteiros.Parceria: trabalhamos lado a lado com nossos clientes — na vitória e no desafio.

Familiaridade com estruturação de fundos de recebíveis e cessão de crédito é um diferencial, não um requisito. Os nomes mais alinhados ao projeto serão contatados pela nossa equipe. Na primeira fase de avaliação, infelizmente, não é viável oferecer um retorno individualizado e detalhado; quem avança no processo é comunicado e acompanhado a cada etapa. Curiosidade, aprendizado contínuo e interesse constante pelas novas tecnologias em Inteligência Artificial. Visão estratégica para identificar oportunidades de inovação e geração de valor para o negócio.

operação de tesouraria da companhia, assegurando a eficiência operacional e a segurança na liquidação de transações de arranjos de pagamento (BIN Sponsor), infraestrutura de mercado (SPB/SPI), gestão Sponsor).Monitoramento diário das posições financeiras, movimentação dos fundos de liquidação e conciliação dos relatórios operacionais e financeiros das bandeiras.Gestão de garantias e colaterais de saldos e controle de filas).Gestão e operacionalização de contas correspondentes em moeda eletrônica para viabilizar transações internacionais, remessas e liquidações cruzadas para clientes de Baa S, garantindo conciliação e aderência às regras do Bacen para facilitadores de pagamentos internacionais (e FX).Execução do fluxo de caixa corporativo diário e projetado (Cash Flow Management).Gestão da política de investimentos e alocação de recursos próprios e de terceiros (renda fixa, TPF, compromissadas), respeitando as normas de segregação patrimonial do Banco Central para IPs.Gestão da relação institucional e operacional com Sponsor Banks, bancos liquidantes e custodiantes.Negociação de tarifas, spreads, limites operacionais e SLAs para dar escala aos produtos de Baa S.Garantir a aderência às normas regulatórias aplicáveis a Instituições de Pagamento e emissores de moeda eletrônica.Liderar melhorias, automações e integrações via API no TMS (Treasury Management System) e sistemas dos liquidantes.Quem estamos buscando? A Swap é uma plataforma de tecnologia especializada em soluções financeiras B2 B, criando infraestrutura para que empresas lancem seus próprios produtos financeiros e gerem mais riqueza dentro de seus ecossistemas. Geramos impacto direto na vida de milhares de empresas e milhões de trabalhadores no Brasil.Aqui, acreditamos que o futuro do Baa S nasce da combinação entre especialização, tecnologia, parceria e propósito. Acesse go. e conheça nosso universo debenefícios. Somos uma das maiores empresas de serviços do mundo, em Auditoria, Consultoria, Impostos, Estratégia e Transações, orientados à Tecnologia. Aqui, acreditamos que a força que impulsiona a inovação vem da diversidade de pessoas e ideias, por isso nossas vagas são destinadas para todas as pessoas.Oferecemos o suporte necessário, provendo acessibilidade para pessoas com deficiência, aplicação de metodologia de trabalho assistido para pessoas com deficiência intelectual e neurodiversas, assim como incentivamos a divulgação de vagas afirmativas para as pessoas Pretas e Pardas e, como o Programa de Entry-level exclusivo para Pc D. A EY também conta com o grupo de afinidade Abilities+ que promove ações internas para a construção de um ambiente mais inclusivo. Segundo o Great Place to Work 2023, somos a melhor empresa para Pessoas Pretas e Mulheres do Brasil e, a 2a melhor empresa para pessoas LGBTQ+. Além disso,você poderá fazer parte de nossos programas e grupos que, juntos a inúmeras iniciativas internas, apoiam nossa constante busca pela equidade.
